image_description: A close-up shot of a male Brambling (Fringilla montifringilla) perched on the edge of a white bird feeder. The bird displays characteristic breeding plumage with a black head, orange-rufous breast, and black back with white shoulder patches. It is facing right, gripping the edge of the feeder. A second, out-of-focus bird is visible in the background to the left.

To verify the physical interaction between the toes and the feeder edge, ensuring no fusion or floating limbs.
